entries.name: 玄珀
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished square pixel-art NPC dialogue bust for a classic 16-bit Japanese fantasy RPG, readable at 96 by 96 pixels. Subject: Xuanpo, an intelligent nonhuman mineral-bodied Ashen clan chief. He is made ENTIRELY of naturally interlocking layered black-grey basalt plates and angular slate, with broad powerful compact shoulders and a recognizably sapient but clearly INORGANIC head. His head is an asymmetrical cluster of dark basalt slabs, no human skin anywhere. A wide WHITE QUARTZ brow ridge contrasts against the dark stone; two small inset amber crystalline eye points look calmly watchful from under this ridge. Faceted stone cheek ridges, a narrow jagged seam rather than fleshy lips, no nose flesh. The upper chest contains ONE visible inset AMBER mineral core in a natural stone socket, distinct from his eye points; warm mineral glow, not fire. A simple weathered dark woven shoulder wrap marks an experienced leader without a crown. Mood dignified, protective and observant. No human hair, no human beard, no burned human skin, no flames, no lava cracks, no horns, no fire demon, no skull, no crown, no metal robot or mechanical parts. Composition: one chest-up three-quarter bust; entire head fits in square with small top margin, amber chest core visible near bottom center, head fills 50 percent of image height. Style: truly crisp chunky hand-placed pixel clusters, clear hard stepped contours, small limited 16-bit palette, selective dark outlines, natural front-left light. Native low-resolution sprite portrait, not a smooth painting or 3D rendering. Plain solid dark desaturated blue-green background in #172c31 family. No text, names, letters, border, frame, badge, watermark, scenery, extra figures or montage.
